title: Reproducible OCI bundle signing and deterministic bootstrap scripts for air-gapped installs
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Customers running private, air-gapped installs need cryptographically verifiable, reproducible installer bundles they can mirror into immutable registries and audit. This PR introduces deterministic bundling and an opinionated signing flow so operators can verify artifacts offline. Summary of changes: 1) New OCI index generator that produces content-addressable indexes with stable ordering and reproducible manifest digests. 2) Bundle signing tool that emits detached GPG + SHA256 manifest files alongside OCI tarballs; verification CLI is included for offline validation. 3) Deterministic bootstrap scripts for kubelet and runtime preloads (RHCOS/Flatcar/Ubuntu) that remove timestamps and non-deterministic tar ordering to make delta bundles reproducible. 4) Terraform module tweaks to registry-mirror to accept signed-bundle metadata and expose artifact ACLs for mirror automation. 5) Chart and values additions for private-installer to surface verification flags and signature public-key config. Backwards compatibility: unsigned bundles are still supported but installer now warns and logs mismatch severity. Migration notes: a migration utility is included to re-index existing local vendor caches into the new reproducible layout. Testing: unit tests for indexer and verifier, integration runs against k3s and kubeadm single-node air-gapped clusters in CI mirror job, and manual validation in an internal staging rack with a private registry. Security review: signing key handling documented and KMS/HSM integration recommended for production keys. Rollback plan: installer falls back to previous unsigned behavior if verification fails and operator provides --force-allow-unsigned; this is logged and emitted as an alert to the console. Checklist: [x] Design doc linked [x] Unit tests added [x] Integration e2e added [x] Docs updated [x] Security review notes applied.
